public.text: In the trusted personal health-record example, identity, longitudinal records, and consent are mapped to the Client Registry and LHR, with information surfaced through a digital health wallet. This may imply that a digital wallet is the preferred or necessary access mechanism.
public.suggestedRevision: Describe the wallet as one possible access channel alongside portals, applications, printed or verifiable documents, assisted access, and other nationally appropriate mechanisms.
